_doc: Revert-verify mutants for vault-exodev ems__Bug 0b24c745 (a query constant keeps its base direction; the direction is bound to ITS literal, not to its language) and ems__Bug 97ebe042 (a language-tagged constant is the language-tagged literal; `=` / `!=` compare the language tag and direction of any literal). Each mutant removes one guarantee and must redden exactly the axes in `expect` (pairwise distinct within the spec). `red_re` anchors on the jest failure header `● <suite> › <axis> `. `tree`/`subject` are placeholders — run the matrix on a copy with the paths substituted. Subject: a language-tagged constant evaluates to the language-tagged Literal.

X1_tagged_constant_as_text._note: A tagged constant evaluates to its bare text again (the pre-fix state of ems__Bug 97ebe042): LANG is "" (T8, the precondition in T11), BIND drops the tag, `=` sees a simple literal. K2 turns red too, and must: the language-aware `=` WITHOUT this half makes the stored "x"@ru = "x"@ru false — the two halves of 97ebe042 ship together.
X1_tagged_constant_as_text._note_split: T22 — the store-matching half of the former T15 (split at the specification stage, 11.11); no longer T15: the EXISTS-filter forms compare the bound value and the constant both as text, so they still agree; the store join is what this mutant breaks (T22).
X1_tagged_constant_as_text._note_review: Axes added at the specification stage (11.11): T24 — as bare text "x" = "x"@en is a text comparison and true; T26 — DATATYPE of bare text is xsd:string.
